title: 第二十五章 暂别银海湾第二十六章 伊万要野爬
content_zh:
醒来后的十分钟，是一天中最惬意最放松的时刻，大脑还在进行启动预热，不会去想今天要做什么，预计会发生什么，要应付什么，要吃什么，要去哪里，这十分钟显得那么的纯净，像深山里的山泉水，如果不想这一泓纯净的山泉水，那么就不要拿起手机看几点，说是看是几点，其实就是想看昨晚睡着的时候有什么微信甚至红包给错过了，那么这一天还没真的开始就已经被污染了，这一天能有什么好心情呢？醒来第一时间只是用手机看时间的话，说明还是有时间观念的。
不过很是奇怪的就是，每逢工作日，早上就没有像起床的意思，到了周六日和节假日，早上却很早很早的醒来了。
我侧躺在床上，没有看手机，真有重要的事，要找我的人早就打电话N次了。
看着阳台上正在运动的应验，仿佛看见了若干年前的自己，当年我也是热爱运动注重锻炼的好孩子。
我翻了个身，应验听到了，回头对我说了声林凡哥早，我声音慵懒的回了一个早字。
早？不知道时间点数怎么说早呢？我一下子就穿越回到鲁迅小时候的三味书屋，看着那个人龇牙咧嘴的用力一刀一划的刻上了这个字，在这个个个人都以为幻想就能任意穿越到过去和未来的环境，我也来幻想一下，然后就后怕了一下穿越回三味书屋是不是一个错误的选择，因为这个有坚定意志去上课的人，居然带刀回课堂，而且一刀一划的笔画似乎先后顺序有误。
来到一个陌生的环境，只要那铺床足够的柔软舒适，不会因为陌生的环境睡不着或早醒。
嗯，这铺床不错，好像和以奥地利首都为名字的那个酒店标榜的舒适床垫还要舒服，我还可以赖赖床。
但凡有这样侥幸心理的，一定不会得逞。
想一下都不行，才有这想的苗头冒出来，我的微信响了，朦朦胧胧中从枕头底下摸出手机，原来是微信视频电话，一看是老婆打过来的，点开，视频里出现的是女儿的样子，咿咿呀呀的说着我听不懂的内容，她只要见到我、我只要见到她，心情就完全不同的了，暴雨天也能化作彩虹季。
我立刻完全清醒过来，对着视频里的女儿问她怎么这么早起床，她似乎听得懂但是不会回应，老婆在旁边问：“什么时候回来？”
我说：“今天就回来了。”
老婆说：“那好。
你爸妈正在找你呢！”
我说：“我没接过电话和微信呀！”
老婆说：“他们想和你说什么，你自己知道的啦！”
不用说，还是工作和梦想的抉择归类问题。
从大院子出来的老一辈总是力求稳定的工作，最初我也有着这样的想法，后来接触的社会层面多了，觉得自己还是能试试放手一搏的，只是没想到这样放手一搏就试了十几年，还没个底儿，能免让人焦虑，做父母的看在眼里，他们比你的焦虑大上一倍的升级版焦虑像个肿瘤般藏在心里你却不知道，过去我总不耐烦他们的说教，等到现在自己有了孩子了，便逐渐开始理解和和体会他们的心情，养儿一百岁，常长忧九十九。
每次说这个，我便声音小了许多，父母年龄大了，受不了什么刺激，只能婉转的说我很好。
儿子又到了叛逆时期，说不得打不得，每次和他交谈，都要小心翼翼的找好话题或者切入点，声音也不能不耐烦，但太没原则也不行，太没原则，这家伙就像觊觎清朝土地的西方列强，觉得你可随意欺负，进而过分要求。

这家伙从来就是这样。
上有老下有小都要应付，夹在中间，还要应付工作和梦想，是个男人怎么都要咬牙抗住。
想到这里，赖床的美好时光就立即结束了。
我对老婆说：“我得起床了，早上吃了早餐就回来。”
老婆说了声好就盖了视频。
是时候暂时回归现实生活里去了，毕竟现实生活中的一切才是生活的一切。
我对应验说：“吃完早餐咱们就往回走。
你和小陈他们说一声，待会儿在楼下餐厅见。”
应验应了一声便开始联系小陈。
我从床上坐了起来，发了一会儿呆，貌似什么都没想，痴呆症般的，其实在想该如何和矮仔成说。
好端端的一件事，也没想过会搞成这样。
是不是我们也太快了一点，如果按照程序，还没轮到这点该担心的事呢！
只要整个事情的正能量舆论大过其他的，我和矮仔成所产生的分歧就完全自然消失。
对了，所以不用纠结，像往常来银海湾那样道别就是了。
打开微信，点了“矮仔成”
“家成，我们今天往回走了。
回聊。”
content_en:
The ten minutes after waking up are the most comfortable and relaxing moments of the day. The brain is still warming up and does not think about what to do today, what is expected to happen, what to deal with, what to eat, and where to go. These ten minutes seem so pure, like spring water in the deep mountains, such as If you don’t want this pure mountain spring water, then don’t pick up your phone to check what time it is. You may say you are checking what time it is, but in fact you just want to check what WeChat messages or even red envelopes you missed while you were sleeping last night. Then the day has already been polluted before it really begins. How can you be in a good mood on this day? If you just use your phone to check the time the first time you wake up, it means you still have a sense of time.
But what is very strange is that on working days, I don't feel like getting up in the morning. On Saturdays, Sundays and holidays, I wake up very early in the morning.
I lay on my side on the bed without looking at my phone. There was something really important. The person who wanted to see me had already called me N times.
Looking at Fuli who is exercising on the balcony, I seem to see myself a few years ago. Back then, I was also a good kid who loved sports and paid attention to exercise.
I turned over and Yingye heard it. He turned around and said "Good morning, Brother Lin Fan". I replied in a lazy voice.
morning? I don’t know how to tell the time early? I was immediately transported back to the Sanwei Bookstore where Lu Xun was a child, watching the man with a grin on his face as he carved this word with a knife and a stroke. In this environment where everyone thought that fantasy could allow them to travel to the past and the future at will, I also fantasized about it, and then I was afraid that traveling back to the Sanwei Bookstore was a wrong choice, because this person who had a strong will to go to class actually brought a knife back to class, and the strokes of the knife and strokes seemed to be in the wrong order.
When you come to a strange environment, as long as the bed is soft and comfortable enough, you won't be unable to sleep or wake up early because of the strange environment.
Well, this bed is good. It seems to be even more comfortable than the comfortable mattress advertised by the hotel named after the Austrian capital. I can still stay in bed.
Anyone who has such a fluke mentality will definitely not succeed.
I couldn't even think about it for a moment, and then the idea came to me. My WeChat message rang, and I took out my phone from under the pillow. It turned out to be a WeChat video call. I saw it was my wife calling, and I clicked on it. What appeared in the video was my daughter, babbling and saying something I couldn't understand. As long as she sees me and I see her, my mood will be completely different. A rainy day can also turn into a rainbow season.
I immediately woke up completely and asked my daughter in the video why she got up so early. She seemed to understand but would not respond. My wife asked next to me: "When will you come back?"
I said, "I'll be back today."
My wife said, “That’s good.
Your parents are looking for you! "
I said: "I didn't answer the phone or WeChat!"
My wife said, "You know what they want to tell you!"
Needless to say, it is still a matter of choosing between work and dreams.
The older generation who came from big courtyards always strived for a stable job. I had the same idea at first. Later, when I came into contact with more aspects of society, I felt that I could still give it a try. But I didn’t expect that I would give it a try and try for more than ten years. I still have no foundation. It can avoid people’s anxiety as a parent. You can see in your eyes that their anxiety is twice as big as yours. The upgraded version of anxiety is hidden in your heart like a tumor, but you don’t know it. In the past, I was always impatient with their preaching. But now that I have a child, I gradually begin to understand and appreciate their mood. I have a child who is one hundred years old, and I often worry about ninety-nine.
Every time I say this, my voice becomes much softer. My parents are older and can't stand the stimulation, so they can only say that I'm fine.
My son has reached the rebellious stage again, and he can't be beaten even if he says it. Every time you talk to him, you have to carefully find the right topic or entry point, and your voice must not be muted.Be patient, but being too unprincipled is not enough. If you are too unprincipled, this guy is like the Western powers that covet the land of the Qing Dynasty. They think you can bully them at will, and then make excessive demands.
This guy has always been like this.
There are seniors, seniors and juniors all having to deal with. Being caught in the middle, you also have to deal with work and dreams. A man has to grit his teeth and resist no matter what.
Thinking of this, the good time of lying in bed ended immediately.
I said to my wife, "I have to get up. I'll be back after breakfast in the morning."
My wife said hello and blocked the video.
It's time to return to real life for a while. After all, everything in real life is everything in life.
I said to the experiment: "Let's go back after breakfast.
You tell Xiao Chen and the others and meet them in the restaurant downstairs later. "
Yingying responded and started to contact Xiao Chen.
I sat up from the bed and was in a daze for a while, seemingly not thinking about anything, like a dementia, but actually I was thinking about how to talk to Chao Zaicheng.
It's such a good thing, I never thought it would turn out like this.
Could it be that we were too fast? If we followed the procedure, it would not be our turn to worry about this!
As long as the positive public opinion about the whole matter is greater than others, the differences between Aizicheng and I will disappear completely and naturally.
By the way, so don't worry, just say goodbye as you usually do when you come to Silver Bay.
Open WeChat and click "Ai Zai Cheng"
"Jia Cheng, we are going back today.
Chat back. "
